heading: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 46: Vishal Chaturvedi and Shobhinaw Satyaa's biopic on Neem Kaorli Baba earns Rs 4 crore India net, worldwide gross crosses Rs 352 crore
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 23:02 IST
paragraphs: 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its remarkable late-stage box office run, entering Day 46 with its India net collection now standing at Rs. 272.09 crore

What began as a slow, underwhelming opener has turned into one of the most unlikely long-haul successes of the year, powered by devotee support and sustained word-of-mouth, with the film's worldwide gross now inching towards the Rs. 350 crore mark

With its India net collection already at Rs. 272.09 crore, 'Hanuman Ansh' now has the Rs. 275 crore domestic mark firmly within reach, a milestone it could breach within the day given its current pace

On the global front, with the worldwide gross already past Rs. 347 crore, a push towards Rs. 350 crore looks imminent, keeping the film's extraordinary long-run success firmly intact as it continues to defy expectations set during its underwhelming opening weeks.'Hanuman Ansh's domestic box office runThe film’s theatrical journey has been defined by a significant turnaround. 'Hanuman Ansh' started with just Rs. 1.08 crore in its opening week, followed by Rs. 0.40 crore in Week 2

However, its fortunes changed dramatically from Week 3, when it collected Rs. 10.40 crore.The film then delivered Rs. 61 crore in Week 4, Rs. 90.25 crore in Week 5 and Rs. 80.25 crore in Week 6, taking its cumulative India net to Rs. 243.38 crore before the seventh-weekend earnings

It subsequently added Rs. 5 crore on Day 43, Rs. 9.75 crore on Day 44 and Rs. 13.75 crore on Day 45, taking the total to Rs. 271.88 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ overseas collection and worldwide totalThe film has also maintained a strong overseas contribution during its extended theatrical run
After Day 45, its overseas gross stood at Rs. 26 crore, while the India gross had reached Rs. 321.05 crore

This put the worldwide gross at Rs. 347.05 crore at the end of Day 45.'Hanuman Ansh' Day 46 collection As per Sacnilk, on Day 46, ‘Hanuman Ansh’ recorded a net collection of Rs. 4.00 crore in India across 7,629 shows

With this, the film’s total India gross collection has reached Rs. 325.80 crore, while its India net collection stands at Rs. 275.88 crore.The film earned another Rs. 0.50 crore from overseas markets on Day 46, taking its cumulative overseas gross collection to Rs. 26.50 crore
As a result, 'Hanuman Ansh' has now amassed a worldwide gross of Rs. 352.30 crore

Day wise collections for 'Hanuman Ansh'Week 1: Rs. 1.08 croreWeek 2: Rs. 0.40 croreWeek 3: Rs. 10.40 croreWeek 4: Rs. 61.00 croreWeek 5: Rs. 90.25 croreWeek 6: Rs. 80.25 croreDay 43: Rs. 5.00 croreDay 44: Rs. 9.75 croreDay 45: Rs. 13.75 croreDay 46: Rs. 4.00 croreTOTAL: Rs. 275.88 croreMore about 'Hanuman Ansh'Directed and written by Vishal Chaturvedi, Hanuman Ansh is a spiritual drama inspired by the life, teachings and legacy of Neem Karoli Baba
The story follows a young boy who, after suffering a devastating loss, embarks on a transformative spiritual journey
The film explores themes of faith, compassion, humility and selfless service
Shobhinaw Satyaa leads the film, with Vihaan Shedge, Chandan K Anand, Purnima Tiwari, Anil Rastogi and Gulshan Pandey among the other members of the cast
The film has been certified U by the CBFC and has a reported runtime of around 2 hours and 30 minutes
It was released theatrically in Hindi on August 7, 2026.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources
All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance
These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized
